page.layout: One column of running text, with no marginal notes. The left edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: stitas[?] Ignatij in periculo haud vertitur, sed stat aliorum itidem testimonijs altissimis defixa radicibus. Menologium Sirletanum die 23. Octobris. Eodem die commemoratio Patris nostri Ignatij Patriarchae Constantinopo-litani. Hic fuit vir generis splendore illustris, sed vita, & moribus illustriori post multas aerumnas, quas Photij opera perpessus est, quievit in Domino. Gregorius Hieromonachus Responsione in Professionem Fidei Marci Ephesii.

p.i: Εἰ δ᾽ ὁ Φώτιος Πατριάρχης ἀπῆν· Ἀλλ᾽ ὅμως ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις ἐστὶ [illegible, ~20 letters] καὶ [illegible, ~25 letters] Ἰγνατίου [illegible, ~10 letters] Φωτίου [illegible, ~20 letters] ἀναθεματίζεσθαι.

main_text.p: Quod si Photius Patriarcha dixit: Sed animadvertito, Photium non esse in Sanctorum numero collocatum, licèt una infimul, & eodem tempore vixerint Photius & Ignatius. Sed hic quidem inter Sanctos adnumeratur, & vigesima tertia Octobris in Synaxariis locum habet. Photius vero nullo modo sanctitatis nomen consequutus est. page.notes: Top line: the first letters are cut or unclear, so "stitas" is uncertain. Greek paragraph: most of the Greek is too faint to read letter by letter, so those stretches are marked illegible. Only the opening words, Ἀλλ᾽ ὅμως and Ἰγνατίου and Φωτίου, are fairly clear. "Photiuum" is printed that way and left as is. "illustriori" and "licèt" / "vero" are read at low resolution and should be checked against the original.
